page.noPermission: You do not have permission to access data transfer.

standard.title: Standard export
standard.description: Operational and configuration data only — rooms, rate plans, promotions, loyalty programmes, settings. Guest, booking, payment, and staff records are excluded.

full.title: Full export
full.description: Every transferable entity including sensitive business data — guests, bookings, payments, ledgers, staff and operational history.
full.tagline: Confidential — contains guest and financial data

backup.title: Full system backup
backup.description: The complete transferable dataset plus relationship metadata, in a migration-ready format. Use for disaster recovery or moving to a new server.
backup.tagline: Confidential — the whole dataset with FK metadata

export.secretsExcluded: Passwords, sessions, tokens, passkeys, and other secrets are never included in any export.
export.sensitiveConfirmBody: The file includes guest profiles, bookings, payments, and operational records. Store it securely and share it only through approved channels.
export.sensitiveConfirmAck: I understand this file contains confidential data and must be handled securely.

stepUp.title: Confirm your identity
stepUp.description: This is a privileged operation. Re-enter your credentials to continue — verification is valid for 2 minutes and bound to this session.
stepUp.totpHint: Required if your account has two-factor authentication enabled.

import.sensitiveWarning: This file contains sensitive business data — guest, booking, payment, or staff records. Importing it requires the data_transfer:import_sensitive permission.
import.missingPermissions: Your account cannot run this import — it requires: {{permissions}}
import.restoreRequiresPermission: Restore requires the data_transfer:restore permission and re-authentication.
import.restoreStepUp: Restore requires re-authentication — verify your identity to continue.

history.serverBacked: Every export, import, and re-authentication on this server is recorded in the audit log.
